items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Yeah, I used to play with Lawrence. Lawrence used to play bands in the band with us.

ctx.x: Well we'd play for them fuelings, like the Charity and the Liberty and things like that. They'd play them.
Did you talk about the Moreiros? Did you play with the band? Lawrence Morello?
Yeah, I used to play with Lawrence. Lawrence used to play bands in the band with us.
